rationale: I AM NOT SAYING THAT THIS DECISION WAS A BLUNDER! I just want it analyzed and its results shown to me. We shuffled away an Ignition Energy that could have been given to Cinderace. Cinderace's attack then attaches 3 basic energies to our bench. Ignition Energy to Cinderace is not the ideal use of the special energy, but it can work. On this turn, powering Cinderace is our critical missing piece. You gambled that sure thing away with Lillies and was rewarded with 2 basic energy. Id like you to run this decision back with the probability of Lillies drawing us an energy card. This time it worked out, next time it might not. id like to explore the chances and a probability threshold that we are comfortable with.

CRITICAL: Only if we could promote a powered Starmie would this have been the correct choice. Otherwise we need Cinderace to power out bench with Turbo Flare. Also, Turbo Flare does more damage than Staryu's Water Gun. Clearly the discounted damage of Starmie's Jetting Blow has leaked into this immediate damage value equation, which is sensical but also wrong. That equation needs refinement.
